summary: permutations creates a list of ordered arrangements of a list's elements; unlike combinations, order matters.
questions: What's the difference between permutations and combinations filters?
How do I generate all orderings of list items?

answer_card.title: permutations filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ mylist | permutations(n) }}` creates lists of permutations of the elements. Unlike `combinations`, **order is significant**.
